_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM) Procedure Validation Report
summary: Defines the format, content, and preparation instructions for the RCM Procedure Validation Report, which evaluates a proposed maintenance task to determine if it is safe, technically sound, and practical.
use_relationship:
The Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM) Procedure Validation Sheet evaluates the proposed maintenance task and determines if the task is safe, technically sound and the most practical method of accomplishing the maintenance action.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, preparation instructions and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described in 5.1.11 of MIL-STD-3034A.
This DID is related to DI-PSSS-80979B, RCM Master Systems and Subsystems Index (MSSI); DI-PSSS-80994B, RCM Functional Block Diagram (FBD); DI-PSSS-80981B, RCM Functional Failure Analysis (FFA) Report; DI-PSSS-80983B, RCM Additional Functionally Significant Item (AFSI) Selection Report; DI-PSSS-80982B, RCM Functionally Significant Items (FSI) Index; DI-PSSS-80980B, RCM Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA) Report; DI-PSSS-80984B, RCM Decision Logic Tree Analysis (LTA) with Supporting Rationale and Justification Report; DI-PSSS-80985B, RCM Servicing and Lubrication Analysis (SLA) Report; DI-PSSS-80989B, RCM Inactive Equipment Maintenance (IEM) Requirement Analysis Report; DI-PSSS-81829A, RCM Corrective Maintenance (CM) Development Report; DI-PSSS-80986B, RCM Maintenance Requirements Index (MRI); DI-PSSS-80988B, RCM Task Definition Report; DI-PSSS-80990A, RCM Documentation Control Sheet.
This DID supersedes DI-SESS-80987A.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Procedure Validation report shall be in a format similar to that of the sample form of Figure 1 of this DID.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Procedure Validation report shall contain all of the information specified in the sample form of Figure 1 of this DID and as specified in MIL-STD-3034A, paragraph 5.1.11.3.

children.title: Block 1. Local Control Number.
children.content: Enter the unique procedure validation number provided by the Maintenance Coordinating Activity (MCA) for the subsystem, subsystem equipment group, equipment, as applicable, at the lowest hierarchical level that all maintenance on the task definition form is applicable.

children.title: Block 2. Nomenclature.
children.content: Enter the nomenclature of the ship subsystem, subsystem equipment group, equipment, as applicable.

children.title: Block 4. MRC Serial Number.
children.content: Enter the Maintenance Requirement Card (MRC) serial number. If this is a new MRC, enter the proposed number for reference purposes.

children.title: Block 5. Ship, Hull, Facility.
children.content: For ships, enter the ship hull number. For facilities, enter the name of facility.

children.title: Block 6. Workcenter.
children.content: Enter the workcenter responsible for the MRC, if available.

children.title: Block 8. Maintenance Requirement Description.
children.content: Enter a brief task description of the maintenance requirement.

children.title: Block 9. Tag-out Required.
children.content: Enter whether a tag-out is required to safely perform the procedure.

children.title: Block 10. HAZMAT Required.
children.content: Enter if HAZMAT is required to perform the procedure.

children.title: Block 11. Procedure Modification.
children.content: Indicate whether the procedure, as written, will require modification. Appropriate entries for this statement are "YES" and "NO".

children.title: Block 12. Safety Concerns.
children.content: Refer to block 12 of the RCM Task Definition form (phase 10). Enter any additional safety concerns realized during the procedure validation.

children.title: Block 13. Expected Elapsed Time.
children.content: Enter the expected elapsed time to perform the procedure, as written.

children.title: Block 14. Actual Elapsed Time.
children.content: Enter the elapsed time to perform the procedure as determined by the shipcheck. If it is the same as the estimate, enter "SAME".

children.title: Block 15. Personnel Validation.
children.content: Indicate whether the ratings and pay grades required to perform the procedure are valid. Appropriate entries for this statement are "YES" and "NO".

children.title: Block 16. Comments - Narrative.
children.content: Enter recommended changes, in freeform text, in this block to the procedures, personnel, tag-out, HAZMAT, etc. This block shall be used to address deficiencies identified in the preceding yes-no questions.

children.title: Block 17. Date & Location.
children.content: Enter the date the validation was performed and the shipboard location of the equipment, as applicable.

children.title: Block 18. Evaluator.
children.content: Enter contact information for the person performing the validation to include: Name, Title, Activity, Phone Number, and Email address, as applicable.
